record.original_question: Under Martin's Axiom or weaker hypotheses, construct examples realizing any consistent configuration of Borel-cover properties that is not already covered by the four configurations displayed in Figure 3.

evidence.quote: Project 7.1. Find constructions, under Martin’s Axiom or weaker hypotheses, for any of the consistent configurations not covered in Figure 3.

artifact.status_search_result: The question is from Tsaban's milestone of open problems on selection principles (arXiv:math/0312182), where it is posed as a project rather than a single conjecture. Subsequent work (e.g., constructions by Bartoszyński, Tsaban, Miller, Orenshtein, and others) has realized additional configurations under various axioms, but no source establishes that all consistent Borel-cover configurations beyond the originally listed four have been constructed under Martin's Axiom or weaker hypotheses. The overall project status appears to remain partially addressed and largely open, but no definitive resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Selection principles in mathematics: A milestone of open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey by B. Tsaban listing open projects on selection principles, including constructing examples realizing consistent Borel-cover configurations under MA or weaker hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open project in this survey of open problems on selection principles.
